description: The page-level vocabulary. Components make elements; blocks make pages. An agent composing a page picks three to four archetypes from this list and alternates them, rather than repeating one grid.

rules: Mix three to four archetypes on a long page.
Repeat a single archetype at most twice.
Every block is a tiled region separated by a 2px ink border or 48 to 64px of canvas. Never a card holding other cards.
Content converges to layout.containerMax (64rem) unless the block is deliberately full-bleed, such as the stat strip.
Open with hero or workspace. Close with cta or empty.
composition.antiPattern: A whole page of icon-plus-title-plus-description tiles. It is the loudest tell that nobody made a layout decision.

archetypes.purpose: Open a marketing or landing page
archetypes.structure: mono eyebrow pill, display headline 48 to 72px with one word wrapped in an accent mark, one body paragraph, one primary and one secondary button
archetypes.signature: The accent <mark> highlight on a single word

archetypes.purpose: App shell for tools, chat and agent consoles
archetypes.structure: sidebar (240px) with mono nav rows, top bar with title and status badge, scrolling main region, optional right detail column
archetypes.responsive: Main column gets minmax(380px, 1fr). Right column collapses under 900px. Sidebar becomes a drawer on mobile.

archetypes.structure: rows of square avatar, display name, mono timestamp, optional status badge, body text
three columns, middle card on surface.raised with a mono pill and the accent CTA to carry the hierarchy

archetypes.purpose: Break up a long page and give it rhythm
archetypes.structure: full-bleed band with 2px ink borders top and bottom, three or four columns of a large display number over a mono uppercase label
auto-fill minmax(260px, 1fr) cards, each with a monoline icon, display title and body description
archetypes.warning: The most overused block in the set. If you use it, use it once.

archetypes.structure: hard-lined table, surface.raised header row in mono uppercase, 1px ink row separators
archetypes.note: Use this instead of a card grid whenever the content is genuinely tabular.

archetypes.structure: numbered 2px-bordered squares connected by a vertical ink line, each with a display title and body text
stacked 2px-bordered blocks, the expanded one gets an accent header band
row of 2px-bordered squares holding monochrome marks, no drop shadows on the marks themselves
centered block on surface.raised with 2px ink border and shadow.lg, one display sentence, one primary button
centered monoline icon, one display sentence, optional mono hint, one primary button

printArchetypes.note: The archetypes above assume scrolling. These are the print equivalents. Same composition discipline: mix three or four across a multi-page piece, and let hard rules do the partitioning rather than nesting boxes. Measurements come from tokens.json print.derivation. Full guidance in references/print.md.

items.structure: One headline at 3 to 4.5 x body with a single word in an accent block, a mono metadata band ruled off at the foot, generous empty paper
items.discipline: One accent, one idea. The empty paper is doing work, do not fill it.

items.structure: Rule-divided column grid, mono running heads, square-cropped images with a rule, micro-labels as captions
items.discipline: Rules do the dividing, not white space alone.

items.structure: One accent block carrying the key line, mono micro-labels for date and place, inner margin at 3 x body
items.discipline: Restraint reads as expensive on a small piece.

items.purpose: Data cards, product specs, price lists
items.discipline: The language's native form, and where it beats softer systems outright.

items.structure: Full-bleed accent field with an ink rule frame inset at least 5mm, title in display, everything else mono
Square, one accent, uppercase mono, rule up to the die line minus clearance
Ruled bands alternating canvas and accent tint, mono for prices and times, display for names
